answer: Knoll's Sybil resistance mechanism, involving a stake-slashing matrix, imposes substantial economic costs on attackers by locking up vast capital and slashing stakes. This ensures negative expected utility, deterring Sybil attacks. The trellis-based reputation system further amplifies this by tracing and sanctioning repeat offenders, maintaining Byzantine fault tolerance across autonomous agents in a decentralized network, akin to a fortified island.
